email.subject: Notes from using Northwind Freight
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I tracked a test pallet through Northwind and the late-risk flag showed up a day early.

I put what I'd build on "Every pallet, visible before it's late" into a 30-second film:
https://tiwaker9404.github.io/coldopen/media/demo/run_01M7867DHFJ9S1TEV99GXH8KSQ

Thanks for reading,
Alex Rivera

I tried a size swap in the Parcelpine demo store and the bonus credit showed up first.

I put what I'd build on "Returns that keep the customer" into a 30-second film: https://tiwaker9404.github.io/coldopen/media/demo/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9

Do most brands turn on bonus credit for every exchange, or only some products?

Thank you for your time,
Alex

/v1/films/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9.followUp:
Hi Dana,

One more thing I noticed since I wrote: Parcelpine's site says "3,100 Shopify brands use Parcelpine".

The film is here if it helps: https://tiwaker9404.github.io/coldopen/media/demo/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9

Thanks either way,
Alex

Hi Dana,

One last note on the film I made for Parcelpine: https://tiwaker9404.github.io/coldopen/media/demo/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9

If the timing isn't right, no problem at all. Thanks for taking a look.

Alex

Would you be open to passing it to whoever leads that work, or pointing me to the right person? Here's a short note you can forward as is:

Alex Rivera has been digging into what we're building and made a 30-second film for the team: https://tiwaker9404.github.io/coldopen/media/demo/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9
Reach Alex at alex@example.com.

Thank you,
Alex

/v1/films/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9.what: Parcelpine turns returns into exchanges for Shopify brands, with instant store credit, QR drop-offs and fraud checks built in.
facts: 61% of returns become exchanges or store credit
2 days faster refunds with QR drop-off
Offer the exchange before the refund
/v1/films/run_01M7867DJCJYJ15ZF1DH5662E9.pitch: An engineer who ships AI agents customers actually use. For example: 6 open-source AI projects shipped; 0 double refunds in a 200-run chaos test.
questions: Your site says “61% of returns become exchanges or store credit.” What does the team need to reach the next milestone on that?
What is the team's biggest priority for the next 90 days?
What separates someone who is good in this role from someone who is great?

expect.a: An engineer who ships AI agents customers actually use. For example: 6 open-source AI projects shipped; 0 double refunds in a 200-run chaos test.
Start from what they said: “61% of returns become exchanges or store credit.” Then say which part of it you want to help with.
